"""Reopen saved bytes and separate model-force causes from estimator failures."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
ROOT = Path(__file__).parent/'repo'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
import pysocialforce
from scripts.validation import compare_obstacle_laws_10061 as laws
OUT = Path(__file__).parent/'evidence'/'diagnosis'
findings = {}
for path in sorted(OUT.glob('*.npz')):
    row = json.loads(path.with_suffix('.json').read_text())
    p = np.load(path)['positions']
    if row['case'] == 'V2':
        width=float(row['variant'])
        walls=[(-1,17,3,3),(-1,17,-3,-3)]
        for a,b in [(width/2,3),(-3,-width/2)]:
            walls += [(8,8,a,b),(8,8.1,a,a),(8.1,8.1,a,b),(8.1,8,b,b)]
        cfg=laws.candidate_config(laws.CANDIDATE if hasattr(laws,'CANDIDATE') else ('legacy_refit',10,-.57),.65)
        cfg.scene_config.agent_radius=.28
        cfg.obstacle_force_config.factor=.003
        cfg.obstacle_force_config.threshold=.375
        cfg.obstacle_force_config.sigma=0
        state=np.array([[*p[-1,0],0,0,15,0,.5]])
        sim=pysocialforce.Simulator(state,obstacles=walls,config=cfg)
        sim.peds.assign_desired_speeds(np.array(row['desired_speeds_m_s']))
        forces={type(f).__name__:f().tolist() for f in sim.forces}
        findings[path.stem]={'terminal_state':state.tolist(),'force_components_m_s2':forces,
                            'pair_count':0, 'goal_x':15, 'wall_offset_m':.375,
                            'actual_body_radius_m':.28, 'gap_m':width}
    if row['case'] in {'V3','V4','V6'}:
        a,b=np.triu_indices(p.shape[1],1)
        v=np.diff(p,axis=0)/.1
        counts={'same_heading':0,'head_on':0,'crossing_or_stationary':0}
        depth=[]; densities=[]
        for k in range(1,len(p)):
            dist=np.linalg.norm(p[k,a]-p[k,b],axis=-1)
            mask=dist<.56
            if not mask.any(): continue
            depth.extend((.56-dist[mask]).tolist())
            va,vb=v[k-1,a[mask]],v[k-1,b[mask]]
            denom=np.linalg.norm(va,axis=-1)*np.linalg.norm(vb,axis=-1)
            dot=np.sum(va*vb,axis=-1)/np.maximum(denom,1e-12)
            moving=denom>.01
            counts['head_on']+=int(np.sum(moving & (dot<-.5)))
            counts['same_heading']+=int(np.sum(moving & (dot>.5)))
            counts['crossing_or_stationary']+=int(np.sum(~moving | (np.abs(dot)<=.5)))
            # Independent local centre density: neighbours in 1m disc / pi m².
            for i in np.unique(np.r_[a[mask],b[mask]]):
                densities.append((np.sum(np.linalg.norm(p[k]-p[k,i],axis=-1)<1)-1)/np.pi)
        findings[path.stem]={'overlap_pair_steps':len(depth),'heading_classes':counts,
                           'depth_m_quantiles_50_95_max':np.quantile(depth,[.5,.95,1]).tolist() if depth else [],
                           'local_neighbour_density_per_m2_50_95':np.quantile(densities,[.5,.95]).tolist() if densities else []}
    if row['case'] in {'V5','V6'}:
        findings.setdefault(path.stem,{})['measurement']={k:v for k,v in row.items()
            if k in {'lateral_cm_to_edge_m','onset_m','min_pair_centre_m','onset_threshold_rad_s','baseline_identical_reason'}}
(OUT/'findings.json').write_text(json.dumps(findings,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(findings,indent=2))

compare_contact.py.content:
"""Compare contact-only HFV2000 integration and hard body exclusion."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from pysocialforce import Simulator
from pysocialforce.config import SimulatorConfig


def body(p, v):
    force = np.zeros_like(p)
    for i in range(len(p)):
        for j in range(i):
            delta=p[i]-p[j]; distance=np.linalg.norm(delta)
            depth=max(0.,.56-distance)
            if depth==0: continue
            n=delta/distance if distance>1e-12 else np.array([1.,0.])
            t=np.array([-n[1],n[0]])
            f=(120000/80)*depth*n+(240000/80)*depth*np.dot(v[j]-v[i],t)*t
            force[i]+=f; force[j]-=f
    return force


def run(kind, dt, separated=False, driving=True):
    gap=2. if separated else .4
    state=np.array([[-gap/2,0,0.,.1,10,0,.5],[gap/2,0,0.,-.1,-10,0,.5]])
    cfg=SimulatorConfig(); cfg.scene_config.agent_radius=.28; cfg.scene_config.dt_secs=dt
    def factory(sim,cfg):
        return [lambda: (np.array([[2.,0],[-2.,0]]) if driving else np.zeros((2,2)))+
                (body(sim.peds.pos(),sim.peds.vel()) if kind=='hfv' else 0)]
    if kind=='projection': cfg.pedestrian_contact_rule='projection_v1'
    sim=Simulator(state.copy(),config=cfg,make_forces=factory)
    sim.peds.assign_desired_speeds(np.full(2,100.)) # expose uncapped stiffness; no cap-induced false stability
    depths=[]; speeds=[]
    for _ in range(round(2/dt)):
        sim.step()
        depths.append(max(0,.56-np.linalg.norm(sim.peds.pos()[0]-sim.peds.pos()[1])))
        speeds.append(np.linalg.norm(sim.peds.vel(),axis=-1).max())
    return dict(max_poststep_overlap_m=float(max(depths)),overlap_steps=int(sum(d>0 for d in depths)),
                max_speed_m_s=float(max(speeds)),final_distance_m=float(np.linalg.norm(sim.peds.pos()[0]-sim.peds.pos()[1])))


if __name__=='__main__':
    results={'source':'https://arxiv.org/pdf/cond-mat/0009448',
             'mass_kg':80,'k_N_per_m':120000,'kappa_kg_per_m_s':240000,
             'omega_dt_at_0_1':float(np.sqrt(2*120000/80)*.1),
             'semi_implicit_normal_dt_bound_s':float(2/np.sqrt(2*120000/80)),
             'friction_dt_bound_at_depth_0_16_s':float(80/(240000*.16))}
    for law,dt in [('hfv',.1),('hfv',.0005),('projection',.1)]:
        results[f'{law}_{dt}']=run(law,dt)
        results[f'{law}_{dt}_separated']=run(law,dt,separated=True,driving=False)
    path=Path(__file__).parent/'evidence'/'contact_comparison.json'
    path.write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))

"""Compare every tracked config/schema/golden file against the CALFIT base bytes."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).parent/'repo';BASE='e6d52b556e2b0f82ccb0a6efd2c7ac17fffa6e36'
entries=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','-z',BASE],cwd=ROOT).split(b'\0')
selected=[]
for raw in entries:
 if not raw:continue
 meta,path=raw.split(b'\t',1);p=path.decode()
 if p.startswith('configs/') or any(token in p.lower() for token in ('schema','golden')):
  mode,typ,oid=meta.split()
  if typ==b'blob':selected.append((p,oid.decode()))
proc=subprocess.Popen(['git','cat-file','--batch'],cwd=ROOT,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
rows=[]
for path,oid in selected:
 proc.stdin.write((oid+'\n').encode());proc.stdin.flush()
 header=proc.stdout.readline().split();size=int(header[2]);before=proc.stdout.read(size);proc.stdout.read(1)
 current=ROOT/path
 after=current.read_bytes() if current.is_file() else None
 rows.append({'path':path,'base_sha256':hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),'current_sha256':hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest() if after is not None else None,'identical':before==after})
proc.stdin.close();proc.wait()
out=ROOT.parent/'evidence/protected_byte_comparison.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps({'base_sha':BASE,'head_sha':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),'count':len(rows),'all_identical':all(r['identical'] for r in rows),'files':rows},indent=2))
print(len(rows),'files; all identical:',all(r['identical'] for r in rows))
if not all(r['identical'] for r in rows):raise SystemExit(1)

"""Uncongested flux-density and walking speed controls for both contact candidates."""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from pysocialforce import Simulator
from pysocialforce.config import SimulatorConfig
from pysocialforce.simulator import make_forces
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
from compare_contact import body

rows=[]
for seed in [1001,1002,1003]:
 for density in [.05,.1,.2]:
  rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); spacing=1/np.sqrt(density)
  xx,yy=np.meshgrid(np.arange(4)*spacing,np.arange(3)*spacing)
  p=np.column_stack([xx.ravel(),yy.ravel()])+rng.uniform(-.005,.005,(12,2))
  state=np.column_stack([p,np.tile([1.29,0.],(12,1)),p+np.array([1000.,0.]),np.full(12,.5)])
  desired=rng.normal(1.29,.19,12)
  reference=None
  for law in ['off','hfv','projection']:
   cfg=SimulatorConfig();cfg.scene_config.agent_radius=.28;cfg.scene_config.enable_group=False
   if law=='projection':cfg.pedestrian_contact_rule='projection_v1'
   def factory(sim,cfg):
    fs=make_forces(sim,cfg)
    return fs+[lambda:body(sim.peds.pos(),sim.peds.vel())] if law=='hfv' else fs
   sim=Simulator(state.copy(),config=cfg,make_forces=factory)
   sim.peds.assign_desired_speeds(desired)
   speeds=[];overlaps=0
   for k in range(100):
    sim.step()
    if k>=50:speeds.append(np.linalg.norm(sim.peds.vel(),axis=-1).mean())
    a,b=np.triu_indices(12,1);overlaps+=int(np.sum(np.linalg.norm(sim.peds.pos()[a]-sim.peds.pos()[b],axis=-1)<.56))
   if law=='off':reference=sim.peds.state.copy()
   rows.append(dict(seed=seed,density_persons_m2=density,law=law,
                    mean_speed_m_s=float(np.mean(speeds)),flux_persons_m_s=float(np.mean(speeds))*density,
                    overlap_pair_steps=overlaps,final_state_byte_identical_to_off=bool(np.array_equal(reference,sim.peds.state))))
slopes=[]
for seed in [1001,1002,1003]:
 for law in ['off','hfv','projection']:
  bank=[r for r in rows if r['seed']==seed and r['law']==law]
  slopes.append(dict(seed=seed,law=law,flux_density_slope=float(np.polyfit([r['density_persons_m2'] for r in bank],[r['flux_persons_m_s'] for r in bank],1)[0])))
out=dict(rows=rows,slopes=slopes,domain='uncongested diagnostic, not empirical full-density calibration')
(Path(__file__).parent/'evidence'/'uncongested_comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(slopes,indent=2))
print('All separated bytes equal:',all(r['final_state_byte_identical_to_off'] for r in rows),'overlaps:',sum(r['overlap_pair_steps'] for r in rows))

"""Lane-only seed interception with exact node and stack receipts."""
import json, os, random, traceback
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

ROOT=Path(__file__).parent
SEALED={50036,50140,50331,50403,50813,51339,51709,51767,52094,52175,52257,52671,52850,52971,53020,53198,53239,53636,53671,53779,55022,55379,55568,56170,56966,57077,57113,57494,57943,59019}
CURRENT_NODE=None
EXISTING=json.loads((ROOT/"evidence/tests/origin_main_existing_nodes.json").read_text())["functions"]
class LaneSeedRefusal(RuntimeError):pass

def checked(value):
 if isinstance(value,(int,np.integer)) and (111<=int(value)<=140 or int(value) in SEALED):
  parts=(CURRENT_NODE or '').split('::')
  existing=len(parts)>1 and parts[-1].split('[')[0] in EXISTING.get(parts[0],[])
  permitted=int(value) not in SEALED and existing and os.environ.get('PEDCONTACT_ALLOW_EXISTING_RETIRED')=='1'
  receipt={'existing_main_lineage':existing,'seed':int(value),'node_id':CURRENT_NODE,'pid':os.getpid(),'status':'existing test permitted under ruling' if permitted else 'refused before RNG/reset/step','stack':traceback.format_stack()[:-1]}
  with (ROOT/'evidence/tests/seed_refusals.jsonl').open('a') as out:out.write(json.dumps(receipt)+'\n')
  if permitted:return value
  raise LaneSeedRefusal(f'protected RNG request {value} refused; node={CURRENT_NODE}')
 return value

def pytest_configure(config):
 for owner,name in [(np.random,'seed'),(np.random,'default_rng'),(random,'seed')]:
  original=getattr(owner,name)
  def guarded(value=None,*args,_original=original,**kwargs):return _original(checked(value),*args,**kwargs)
  setattr(owner,name,guarded)

def pytest_runtest_setup(item):
 global CURRENT_NODE
 CURRENT_NODE=item.nodeid

"""Capture one rejected dev1005 contact solve without changing its physics."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,subprocess,traceback
import numpy as np
import yaml
ROOT=Path(__file__).parent/'repo';sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from loguru import logger
logger.remove();logger.add(sys.stderr,level='INFO')
from robot_sf.benchmark.camera_ready_campaign import load_campaign_config,run_campaign
from scripts.validation import run_empty_world_sweep as empty
import robot_sf.sim.simulator as wrapper
from pysocialforce.contact import project_step,MAX_PASSES
from robot_sf.evidence.writers import write_json
arms=['orca','scenario_adaptive_hybrid_orca_v2_bottleneck_yield_v4','scenario_adaptive_hybrid_orca_v2_collision_guard_v4','hybrid_rule_v4_fast_progress_static_escape','hybrid_rule_v4_fast_progress_static_escape_continuous']
index=int(sys.argv[1]);arm=arms[index]
out=ROOT.parent/'evidence/robot_failure_trace/by_arm'/arm;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source=ROOT.parent/'evidence/robot_gate/on/probes'/arm/'1005'
sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip();empty.verify_head(sha)
original=wrapper.apply_contact_step;calls=0

def capture(sim,previous):
 global calls
 calls+=1
 proposed=sim.peds.state.copy();obstacles=np.asarray(sim.get_raw_obstacles(),dtype=float).reshape(-1,6)
 try: original(sim,previous)
 except RuntimeError:
  radius=float(sim.peds.agent_radius)
  corrected,passes,converged=project_step(previous[:,:2],proposed[:,:2],obstacles,radius,True,True,MAX_PASSES,np.zeros(len(proposed),dtype=np.bool_))
  np.savez_compressed(out/'rejected_state.npz',previous=previous,proposed=proposed,corrected=corrected,obstacles=obstacles,radius=radius)
  write_json(out/'rejection.json',{'producer_sha':sha,'arm':arm,'seed':1005,'scenario':'classic_crossing_low','contact_calls':calls,'radius_m':radius,'passes':passes,'converged':bool(converged),'state_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'rejected_state.npz').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'stack':traceback.format_stack()})
  raise
wrapper.apply_contact_step=capture
matrix=yaml.safe_load((source/'matrix.yaml').read_text());matrix['scenarios']=[s for s in matrix['scenarios'] if s['name']=='classic_crossing_low'];assert matrix['scenarios'][0]['seeds']==[1005]
(out/'matrix.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(matrix,sort_keys=False));cfg=yaml.safe_load((source/'campaign.yaml').read_text());cfg['scenario_matrix']=str(out/'matrix.yaml');cfg['resume']=False
(out/'campaign.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(cfg,sort_keys=False));print('RESOLVED SEEDS [1005]',flush=True)
result=run_campaign(load_campaign_config(out/'campaign.yaml'),output_root=out/'campaigns',label='diagnostic',campaign_id='diagnostic',skip_publication_bundle=True,invoked_command='robot_failure_trace.py',arm_isolation='in_process')
write_json(out/'completed.json',result)

print(json.dumps({'mode':mode,'suite':suite,'arm':arm,'resolved_seeds':seen,'scenario_count':len(resolved),'sha':sha}),flush=True)
(out/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps({'head_sha':sha,'driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'mode':mode,'suite':suite,'arm':arm,'resolved_seeds':seen,'scenario_count':len(resolved)},indent=2))
result=run_campaign(cfg,output_root=out/'campaigns',label='gate',campaign_id='gate',skip_publication_bundle=True,invoked_command=' '.join(sys.argv),arm_isolation='in_process')
(out/'completed.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,default=str))
print('COMPLETE',flush=True)

"""Run explicit audited test paths, preserving collection and validation receipts."""
import argparse,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).parent/'repo'; OUT=Path(__file__).parent/'evidence'/'tests'
mode=sys.argv[1]
serial='--serial' in sys.argv
label=mode+('_serial' if serial else '')
files=json.loads((OUT/(mode+'_files.json')).read_text())
env=dict(os.environ,OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',
 XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'),MPLCONFIGDIR=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'/'mpl'),
 NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'/'numba'),TMPDIR=str(ROOT.parent/'tmp'),
 HF_HOME=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'/'hf'),TORCH_HOME=str(ROOT.parent/'cache'/'torch'),
 PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT.parent),PATH=str(ROOT/'.venv/bin')+os.pathsep+os.environ['PATH'],PEDCONTACT_ALLOW_EXISTING_RETIRED=os.environ.get('PEDCONTACT_ALLOW_EXISTING_RETIRED','0'))
(ROOT.parent/'tmp').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
command=[str(ROOT/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-p','lane_seed_guard',*files]
if serial:command+=['-p','no:xdist']
collect=command+['--collect-only','-q']
with (OUT/(label+'_collection.log')).open('w') as log:
 rc=subprocess.run(collect,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
if rc:raise SystemExit(rc)
nodes=[line.split('::')[0] for line in (OUT/(label+'_collection.log')).read_text().splitlines() if '::' in line and not line.startswith(' ')]
excluded={r['path'] for r in json.loads((OUT/'excluded_files.json').read_text())}
if any(node in excluded for node in nodes):raise RuntimeError('excluded file collected')
workers=4 if float(Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().split()[0])>12 else 8
if mode=='full':command+=['--cov=robot_sf','--cov-branch','--cov-report=json:'+str(OUT/'full_coverage.json'),'--cov-report=term:skip-covered']
run=command+([] if serial else ['-n',str(workers)])+['-q',f'--junitxml={OUT}/{label}_junit.xml','--basetemp='+str(ROOT.parent/'tmp'/('pytest_'+label))]
(OUT/(label+'_command.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'command':run,'files':len(files),'workers':workers,'slow_tests_included':True},indent=2))
with (OUT/(label+'_run.log')).open('w') as log:
 rc=subprocess.run(run,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
print(mode,'exit',rc,'files',len(files),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(rc)
